name: Historic Villages of Shirakawa-go and Gokayama
description: Tucked into the snowy Shogawa river valley on the border of Gifu and Toyama in central Japan, these three villages (Ogimachi, Ainokura and Suganuma) are known for their gassho-zukuri farmhouses. Their steep thatched roofs, shaped like hands pressed in prayer, shed heavy winter snow. Families once raised silkworms in the spacious attics of these houses, which are found nowhere else in Japan.
